note: Zorig Chusum — the 13 arts and crafts of Bhutan. Reference data for the HAB website; the set does not change. Order is canonical and drives the 01/13 … 13/13 badges on the landing page cards.

crafts.name: Shingzo
crafts.description: Timber joinery for dzongs, temples and houses — beams, brackets and window frames cut without nails.

crafts.name: Dozo
crafts.description: Stone and rammed-earth walls, the load-bearing craft behind every dzong and farmhouse.

crafts.name: Parzo
crafts.description: Carving in wood, slate and stone: masks, altar panels, printing blocks and mani walls.

crafts.name: Lhazo
crafts.description: Thangka scrolls, murals and decorative motifs painted to classical proportion in mineral pigment.

crafts.name: Jinzo
crafts.description: Clay statues, ritual objects and moulded ornament, built up over a wooden armature.

crafts.name: Lugzo
crafts.description: Casting in bronze, brass and iron — bells, statues, cymbals and household vessels.

crafts.name: Garzo
crafts.description: Forged tools, knives, chains and farm implements, a craft centred on eastern Bhutan.

crafts.name: Troezo
crafts.description: Chased and filigreed silver and gold: koma clasps, jewellery, ritual vessels.

crafts.name: Tshazo
crafts.description: Split bamboo and cane woven into baskets, bangchungs, mats and quivers.

crafts.name: Thagzo
crafts.description: Backstrap and pedal-loom textiles — kira, gho, kisuthara silk and yathra wool.

crafts.name: Tshemzo
crafts.description: Tailoring, appliqué and embroidery, including the giant thongdrel banners.

crafts.name: Shagzo
crafts.description: Bowls and cups turned from burl wood and lacquered, associated with healing properties.

crafts.name: Dezo
crafts.description: Desho paper made by hand from daphne and edgeworthia bark, dried on frames in the sun.
